metrics.name: mc_region_pvp_denied_total
metrics.help: Player-vs-player attacks denied by a region. A FRICTION counter: if it climbs, players are fighting where they can't.

collector.name: region
collector.text:
WorldGuard — protected regions, and what they deny.

Two kinds in one module, deliberately: region COUNT is state, polled; denied PvP is an event, counted. Splitting them would mean two jars for one plugin, which the "one jar per plugin" layout forbids.

Region count is polled in the background: `RegionManager.size()` is cheap, but it requires walking every world, and a region created ten seconds ago doesn't matter to the second.
